speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The third step, Master Bryan, and the third is a courtesy. The stair above it is a lodging.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The third will do, Mistress. John sent me. A gentleman's house is entered in a certain order, and he would have the order said here before Tuesday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we will say bodies, paper, candles and time. We will not say what the guest wants to see. We will not say why.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I was not sent with a why. Nine players and two boys. A floor the size of a counting-house. That is the body of it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nine, and two. The two are the boys we have. I am not naming a new boy on a Sunday stair.

speaker: george_bryan
text: A screen at one end, and that is the tiring-house. Garnish will want a stool behind it. The book does not stand in a gentleman's eye.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: A stool is a stool. I am not lending one of mine to Westminster. I am telling you the step.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You are not being asked, Mistress. The stool is theirs to find.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Candles off the players' feet. Not set where a boot can take them. I will not promise a room I have not stood in.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then we promise nothing we have not seen. Fire stays off the rushes where we stand.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The tide serves at five. It will not serve at midnight. We go up on the flood. We do not pretend the river brings us home.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Old Swan at five. What will not walk can go in a cart. I am not settling the walk home on this step.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The three leaves are in Garnish's chest. They have not been spoken since June. A man who has them in his mouth on Tuesday has them from the chest, not from a memory he prefers.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will have them out tonight, and back before morning. They are not a Sunday recreation. They are Tuesday's.

speaker: george_bryan
text: K. Richard, in Sir Edward's letter, is our king. It is nobody else's. I will not say a further word about the letter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Our king. Nobody else's. That is the whole of the letter for this step.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I have heard a king, a tide and a chest. I have not heard a guest. I am content not to. The third step is as far as the news comes.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Content is right. I am writing the work. I am not writing the reason.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Write the house, the hour and the water. Write the leaves. If the property has a glass, write the glass. Do not write a speech under it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The house, the hour, the water, the leaves, and a glass if we have one. I will put them on the tables when you are off the step.

speaker: george_bryan
text: John will want the nine named in the morning, at the Theatre, and not in this passage. I will tell him the tide and the floor. I will not tell him a sentence we have not been given.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tell him nine and two, and five by water, and the chest. If he asks whose pleasure the supper serves, tell him I was not advised.

speaker: george_bryan
text: I can say that. I have said less, in better rooms, and been thanked for the less.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then be thanked on the step, and go. Evening prayer is done. The house is a house again.

speaker: george_bryan
text: And bow to the chair by the fire, whoever is in it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Whoever is in it. I will tell them in the morning. Not before.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Good night, Mistress. The third step was enough.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: It was the step I had. Good night, Master Bryan.
